{{/* customer_devstation.html — /customers//devstation. Lists every service whose host is the customer's devstation, using the components.service_row primitive (the ADR 0037 row shape made real). */}} {{ define "customer_devstation.body" }} {{ template "components.section" (dict "Title" "Devstation services" "Subtitle" "Runtimes + integrations bound to this customer's devstation host. Click a row to drill into the service detail.") }} {{ if .Services }}
{{ range .Services }} {{ template "components.service_row" (dict "ServiceID" .ServiceID "DisplayName" .ServiceID "Provider" .AuthOverride.Kind "Host" .Host.HostID "AuthKind" .AuthOverride.Kind "AuthStatus" "active" "LastActivity" "—" "Tiers" .TierEligibility "DrillHref" (printf "/customers/%s/devstation/%s" $.Customer.AccountSlug .ServiceID) "PrimaryAction" (dict "Label" "Re-authenticate" "Kind" "primary" "HxPost" (printf "/api/customer-services/%s/reauth/start" .ServiceID) "HxTarget" (printf "#row-%s" .ServiceID)) "Secondary" (list (dict "Label" "Settings" "Href" (printf "/customers/%s/devstation/%s" $.Customer.AccountSlug .ServiceID)) (dict "Label" "Revoke" "Kind" "destructive" "StepUp" true "Confirm" "Revoke this service?"))) }} {{ end }}
{{ else }} {{ template "components.empty_state" (dict "Icon" "🖥️" "Title" "No devstation services" "Message" "This customer's registry file has no services bound to a devstation host.") }} {{ end }} {{ end }} {{ template "components.shell" . }}
